children: HPE raises its full-year fiscal 2026 revenue growth outlook to 34% to 37%, with networking segment growth now expected at 73% to 74%. The company also lifts its non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance to $3.75 to $3.85 for fiscal 2026. For fiscal 2027, HPE now expects revenue growth of 13% to 17% and non-GAAP EPS growth of 16% to 20%. Free cash flow guidance rises to at least $3.75 billion for fiscal 2026 and at least $5 billion for fiscal 2027.
